items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: Oliver sent for me. And I left here from New Orleans and went to St. Louis. It was the King Oliver Band from Chicago.

ctx.x: Yes, both of those are dead. Thomas Batten. So I left out of there. I went with playing dance music, you know, with the other bands out in town. And the original Tuxedo Band, there's four of us made up that band. Ernest Trepania, the drummer. William Risley and myself. And Oscar Salisant. Right at my porch, we had four pieces organized, the original Tuxedo Band. So I played with the Tuxedo for a good while. And the band that split up. Salisant had a Tuxedo. And Risley had the Tuxedo Band. Each one, they had two.…
If you can remember, it'll be fine.

items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: King Oliver. Joe Oliver was called King Oliver. He was playing trumpet... See, King Oliver, Joe Oliver had one band.

ctx.x: King Oliver. Joe Oliver was called King Oliver. He was playing trumpet. Did you play guitar or band?
